name: Dynobite
ingredients_raw: SUGAR POWDER, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL (PALM), MILK SOLIDS, COCOA SOLIDS (4%), MODIFIED STARCH (INS 1401), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALM), DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER (INS 322, INS 475), RAISING AGENT (INS 500(11)), YEAST, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA), FLOUR TREATMENT AGENT (INS 1101, INS 223).
